prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sandy Giza plateau with the great pyramids behind her, a smooth flat sand path and a standard-height stone doorway block at her side, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Filipina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a copper small flared temple bell, a silver cube-shaped block, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold hair ornaments. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Lebanese man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, smooth olive-tan skin, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a lead barrel-shaped weight, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold round bell, a gold pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver ring. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A thick, heavy, extremely strong man built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice fills filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
